svg.title: Acting on a moving target — schematic
svg.desc: Three equal-width panels show ambiguous motion from the same current pose, different future target poses at the same physical application time, and task-role-dependent precision. Command issue times are anchored to capture, uniformly spaced by 50 ms; commands whose issue slots precede chunk arrival expire. Task delay shifts the application time after issue. The illustrated inference latency is two periods and task delay one period, not measured delays. Sparse scene flow covers every role; target SE(3) is additional supervision. Hypothetical geometry, not experimental data.
svg.text: All roles: sparse flow; target adds SE(3).
